### Description

Galactomyces 95 Tone Balancing Essence contains a high concentration of galactomyces ferment filtrate to improve skin tone and texture. It nourishes and hydrates while gradually brightening dullness and refining uneven areas. With regular use, it leaves your skin smoother, clearer, and more radiant.

**Key Features**

• 95% galactomyces ferment filtrate
• Refines texture and balances skin tone
• Promotes hydration and radiance

### How to Use

Use a few drops on clean skin, spread evenly, and pat gently.

### What's in it

Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate, Niacinamide, Panthenol, Glycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Butylene Glycol, Betaine, Sodium Hyaluronate, Allantoin, Xanthan Gum, Ethyl Hexanediol, Adenosine


### Additional Information

100ml

### How do I incorporate this essence into my skincare routine?

Apply this essence after cleansing and toning but before serums and moisturizer. Use 2-3 drops on clean skin, gently patting until fully absorbed for optimal penetration.

### What skin types can benefit from this galactomyces essence?

This essence is suitable for all skin types, especially those with dull, uneven skin tone or rough texture. Its gentle fermented formula makes it ideal for sensitive skin while being effective for oily and combination skin types.

### How long does it take to see visible improvements in skin tone and texture?

Most users notice improved skin hydration within the first week of use. Visible improvements in skin tone, texture, and overall radiance typically become apparent after 2-4 weeks of consistent daily application.
